comment: Gzip bytes a first visit downloads before the app runs (scripts/perf/bundle-report.mjs). Measured 2026-11-13 with `npx vite build` at c157793e3: initial JS 719,611 (one entry chunk), initial CSS 18,996; the limits are about 3% above. CI (after its build) and the push gate fail a build over these; they catch sudden growth, they are not a target. Raise them only on purpose, in the commit that needs it. Raised 2026-11-18 for the memory diagnostics (#612): CI read 724.0 KiB at 22c136833, about 2 KiB above a local build. Raised 2026-11-18 for the native zoom shortcuts (#618): CI read 726.5 KiB on its merge with main. Raised 2026-11-19 for the phone page slide without view transitions (#643): CI read 727.7 KiB on its merge with main. Raised 2026-11-19 for the build tools update (Vite 7, esbuild 0.28): the same sources build an entry 4.0 KiB larger (725.4 to 729.4 KiB in local and gce builds), mostly in the CommonJS packages' wrappers. Raised 2026-11-19 for React Router 7: its router builds an entry 9.0 KiB larger (729.3 to 738.3 KiB in local builds); its production build, which its exports leave out, would save 0.5 KiB. Raised 2026-11-20 for the thread Back loop fix (#691): CI read 742.6 KiB on main after React Router 7, 0.1 KiB under the limit, and 742.7 KiB (760,524 B) on this fix's merge with main. Raised 2026-11-20 for tool markers out of text (#689): CI read 743.3 KiB on main at 18ed47ec1 and 744.2 KiB on this change's merge with it, 0.1 KiB over. What puts the markers back in an agent's text stays in the entry chunk, because the first render reads that text. Raised 2026-11-20 for the phone page slide copying only what shows (#715): CI read 745.8 KiB on this change's merge with main, 0.2 KiB over; the slide runs on the first tap, so its copy stays in the entry chunk. Raised 2026-11-20 for the crash-safe voice recording journal (#714): CI read 747.3 KiB with the journal's roughly 1 KiB in the entry chunk so recovery and cleanup do not depend on a separate download. Raised 2026-11-21 for Mac voice recovery: the first composer imports native audio into the existing journal. Main already reads 748.3 KiB in CI; the updated entry is 767,335 B with CI’s Node 24.22.3. The review fixes add the UUID lock and ownership checks; the entry now measures 767,513 B and exceeds the prior cap in CI.
